findings.title: KJ-01 technical-valid count is inconsistent across retained evidence
findings.impact: The acceptance claim requires internally consistent report and manifest evidence; the differing KJ-01 denominators and technical-valid counts prevent confirming that the sensitivity artifact and validation receipt describe the same production result.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json: KJ-01 = 4,906 all reconstructed tracks and 4,624 technical-valid tracks.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the source run and specimen identifier, regenerate or explicitly cross-reference the affected artifact, and add a validator proving that all retained KJ-01 report, tracking, and sensitivity counts refer to the same frozen inputs.

limitations: Visual review used retained PNG evidence and did not rerun image inference or the full image stack.
The visual panels demonstrate representative examples and cannot establish exhaustive object-level correctness.
recommended_follow_up: Resolve the KJ-01 count discrepancy before acceptance; conditional status blocks the production gate.
